title: AI enthusiast mods BIOS with Claude Code AI defeats RSA-2048 signature checks and unlocks 55 hidden settings
summary: A Redditor successfully modded their HP laptop BIOS using Claude Code AI, bypassing security checks and unlocking 55 hidden settings.
insight: AI-powered BIOS modulation poses significant security risks to hardware and users.

title: Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) foundry roadmaps breaking down TSMC, Intel, Samsung, and GlobalFoundries' approach to next-generation scale-up connectivity
summary: TSMC, Intel, Samsung, and GlobalFoundries are developing co-packaged optics strategies to overcome copper interconnect limitations, enabling faster and more efficient AI computing through optical connectivity.
insight: Next-gen AI systems require faster, more efficient optical connectivity solutions.

title: GPU prices for current-gen Nvidia and AMD: Price increases, why have the prices not dropped, and can you still buy a cheap GPU?
summary: The current-gen GPU market is plagued by price increases due to AI demand, tariffs, and vendor greed, limiting options for affordable PC builds. Despite some minor fluctuations, prices have largely failed to drop. Budget-conscious buyers now face a challenging landscape.
insight: Tariffs, AI demand, and vendor greed drive GPU price surges.

title: World s smallest GPU silicon passes real-world testing 240,000-transistor TinyGPU v2.0 renders 3D graphics at up to 15 FPS while v3.0 prepares for 2026 release
summary: The TinyGPU v2.0, a 240,000-transistor standalone GPU silicon, passed real-world testing, demonstrating 3D graphics rendering at up to 15 FPS. This achievement marks a significant milestone in the development of ultra-compact GPUs. Further advancements are expected with the upcoming TinyGPU v3.0.
insight: Revolutionizing miniature computing with ultra-compact, high-performance GPUs.

title: Hideo Kojima unveils a Death Stranding 2-themed wireless CD player Limited edition device costs ~$160, comes with Bluetooth 5.3 & exclusive artwork
summary: Hideo Kojima and km5 collaborated on a limited-edition CP1 wireless CD player. The device is themed after the BB Pod from Death Stranding 2 and features Bluetooth 5.3. It is priced around $160.
insight: Gaming icon Kojima taps into retro-tech nostalgia market trend

title: Ten years later, the iconic GTX 1080 Ti still holds up in 1080p gaming, but not without showing its age Redux testing highlights the wonders of 11GB VRAM & the woes of time
summary: The GTX 1080 Ti still performs well at 1080p, thanks to its VRAM, but is inefficient by today's standards. A retest by PC Games Hardware highlights the GPU's capabilities and limitations. The results show the 1080 Ti's age in modern gaming.
insight: Efficiency gap highlights GPU's aging, despite VRAM advantages

title: Grab this 240 Hz QD-OLED gaming monitor at just $300 Gigabyte's 27-inch GO27Q24A is now $150 off at Newegg
summary: Gigabyte's GO27Q24A offers a 240Hz QD-OLED gaming monitor with HDMI 2.1 for esports-focused features at a discounted price.
insight: High-refresh-rate gaming monitor at an affordable price point emerges.

title: Errant SpaceX rocket stage set to smash into the moon at 5,400 mph, seven times the speed of sound NASA and South Korean orbiters prepare to track 3-ton TNT impact
summary: A used SpaceX rocket is set to crash on the moon's surface, monitored by two satellites to study its effects.
insight: Preparing for future lunar missions and mitigating potential space debris risks.

title: Microsoft Paint used as a 'monitor' to run Doom at up to 35 fps, project released by firm's Azure CTO runs actual Doom engine and loads real shareware DOOM1.WAD
summary: DoomPaint is a unique project that runs the Doom engine using MS Paint as a viewport, achieving up to 35 fps. Developed by Microsoft's Azure CTO, the project loads the real shareware DOOM1.WAD. This innovative approach showcases the versatility of the Doom engine.
insight: Unconventional use of MS Paint as a gaming viewport is innovative.

title: Iran suspected of conducting cyberattacks on US water suppliers in 45 municipalities small towns mostly targeted, with utilities switching to manual control
summary: US water suppliers in 45 municipalities have been targeted by suspected Iranian cyberattacks, with some towns switching to manual control to protect their water supply. The exact extent of the damage is unclear. The water utilities remain operational, albeit with reduced automation.
insight: Cybersecurity risks threaten US water infrastructure and public health

title: Commemorative golden Doom floppy disks go up for pre-order pair of limited edition dummy imitation gold plating disks and a box are $30 at GameStop
summary: GameStop is selling a limited edition Doom floppy disk replica, made of imitation gold plating, for $29.99. This collectible item is a commemorative nod to the classic game. It comes with a box.
insight: Gamers can relive nostalgia with a retro-inspired collectible item.

title: AMD's upcoming Zen 6 processors could fix microstutters and improve 1% lows in games Next-gen CPUs tipped to feature per-core optimizations for thermal and power budgets
summary: AMD's Zen 6 processors may address microstutters and improve 1% lows in games through per-core optimizations.
insight: Per-core tweaks could significantly boost gaming performance for smoother experiences.

title: First open-source firmware for AM5 officially launches Dasharo v0.9.0 brings Coreboot and openSIL to Zen 4 APUs on MSI B850
summary: 3mdeb has launched Dasharo v0.9.0, an open-source firmware for MSI B850-P WiFi, marking the first time open-source firmware has been introduced to the AM5 platform.
insight: Open-source firmware brings customization and security to Zen 4 APUs on AM5

title: SpaceXAI says it will remove all 69 of its unpermitted turbine power generators, but expects process to take a year trailer-mounted generators to be replaced by 1.2GW power plant
summary: SpaceXAI agrees to remove 69 unpermitted turbines, replacing them with a 1.2GW power plant. The process is expected to take a year, resolving a lawsuit involving pollution and permits. This brings relief to the community.
insight: Community safety and pollution concerns resolved with turbine removal plan.

title: RTX 5060 Ti survives car crash after being bent in half short PCB saves the day, single memory chip resolder restore full performance
summary: A graphics card, specifically the RTX 5060 Ti, survived a car crash with only minor damage due to its short PCB, which limited the impact. The bent card was repaired by resoldering a single memory chip, allowing it to regain full performance.
insight: Short PCBs can increase graphics card survivability in extreme crashes.

title: Prolific Team Fortress 2 collector is selling his in-game case arsenal for an estimated $100,000 1.7 million items collected over 10 years are enough to fund a house purchase
summary: A Team Fortress 2 player is selling a 1.7 million item case collection for $100,000 after nearly a decade.
insight: The collection's value highlights the monetizable assets in online gaming.

title: 28.9M-parameter LLM runs locally on ESP32-S3 at 9 tokens/s
summary: A 28.9M-parameter LLM has been optimized to run locally on an ESP32-S3 development board, achieving 9 tokens/s performance. This demonstrates the potential for offline LLM capabilities on low-power microcontrollers. The project showcases a unique application of ESP32-S3 as a standalone AI device.
insight: Offline AI capabilities on low-power microcontrollers are now feasible.

title: $299.99 ASUS UGen300 USB AI accelerator combines 40 TOPS Hailo-10H chip with 8GB LPDDR4
summary: The ASUS UGen300 USB AI accelerator features a 40 TOPS Hailo-10H chip and 8GB LPDDR4 memory, supporting large language models and AI vision workloads with low power consumption.
insight: Compact AI acceleration for edge devices in a slim USB form factor.

title: Aliensense NXS is a plug-and-play GMSL 2/3 and CAN-FD sensor board for robots
summary: Aliensense NXS is a compact sensor board for robots that connects cameras and sensors with a single GMSL 2/3 cable, offering up to 15 meters of range and extendable to 40 meters over CAN-FD.
insight: Streamlined robotics development with simplified sensor connectivity solutions.

title: Infineon wraps up $650M ams OSRAM sensors buy
summary: Infineon has completed its acquisition of ams OSRAM sensors for $650 million. The move is expected to enable more application-ready designs. This will help Infineon expand its product offerings.
insight: Accelerating innovation with application-ready designs and expanded product offerings

title: Video: The day Edge AI got 'more real' with sensors
summary: Panelists at Sensors Converge share their favorite edge AI use cases in a video snippet. They discuss the applications of edge AI with sensors, which have become more real and practical. The panelists highlight the benefits of integrating edge AI with sensors.
insight: Edge AI with sensors enhances real-time decision-making capabilities

title: Country music stars unite against data centers spreading across rural America
summary: Country music stars are uniting to oppose data centers in rural areas, citing concerns over scale and setting. They argue that such projects would be an eyesore and harm local environments. The issue has gained attention in Nashville and other rural regions.
insight: Rural America's natural landscapes threatened by large-scale data center development

title: Doom now "runs" in Microsoft Paint thanks to a wildly inventive clipboard trick
summary: DoomPaint is a creative solution that runs Doom within Microsoft Paint using ViZDoom, utilizing the genuine shareware DOOM1.WAD for the first episode and Freedoom for other maps.
insight: Innovative use of headless rendering enables unexpected platform combinations.

title: der8auer tests PC chimney effect, dropping CPU temps by 19 C with a 110cm 3D-printed tower
summary: der8auer tests PC chimney effect, achieving a 19°C CPU temp drop using a 110cm tower.
insight: Trapped hot air convection, not just chimney shape, drives cooling efficiency.

title: A Coldcard firmware flaw let hackers drain $70 million in Bitcoin in 41 minutes, with losses now topping $88 million
summary: A firmware flaw in Coldcard wallets allowed hackers to drain $88 million in Bitcoin. The issue exposed a vulnerability in how the device generates its seed. This security breach highlights the importance of robust wallet security.
insight: Weak seed generation compromises wallet security completely

title: AMD's new Zen 6 chips will have a low-power core built from five different generations of Zen
summary: AMD's Zen 6 chips will include a low-power core combining five generations of Zen architecture. This new core is set to be identified in user space to provide accurate CPU topology information. Patch notes suggest improvements to system identification.
insight: Accurate low-power core identification is crucial for optimal system performance.

title: A Meta developer's Linux patch could boost Steam Deck frame rates by up to 32%
summary: David Vernet's Linux kernel patches aim to improve frame rates on AMD-based gaming handhelds, such as the Steam Deck, by addressing stuttering and frame-time spikes. The patches introduce a new operating mode to the amd-pstate driver. This could result in a 32% boost in frame rates.
insight: Optimized kernel patches boost Steam Deck frame rates significantly.
